sentinels.purpose: A table named public.zz_acl_unknown_fixture created in the disposable cluster BEFORE the package runs. Its purpose is to prove the package's section-0 closed-world refusal: the apply must RAISE naming this relation and leave the ACL snapshot byte-identical (PG-05). It must never receive a grant, and its name must appear in the refusal message so the refusal is attributable to the closed-world check and not to an unrelated failure.

A uniquely-valued row planted in ORG_B on each of the 18 readable tables of the 19 (all but commercial_accounts). Under ORG_A's identity context as uellix_app it must never appear in any result set (PG-17 cross-org RLS with two organizations). Its presence in ORG_B's own result set is the positive half that proves the negative half is not vacuous.

A deliberate surplus grant (DELETE on one APPEND_ONLY table to uellix_writer) issued in a fixture BEFORE the package runs. The package must REFUSE as OVERPRIVILEGED PRESTATE rather than silently narrowing (authority SECTION_7 CONVERGENT_APPLICATION_SEMANTICS.precondition_per_table); the surplus must still be present after the refused apply, proving the transaction rolled back and did nothing (N-05).

stella_interactions and, where present, stella_suggestion_decisions, observed before and after apply -- the ONLY two amendments the hosted canon admits (tests/hosted/prechain-ownership.test.ts AMENDMENTS :425-443, admitted at :459-467 only when justified by a package INSTALLED on the hosted chain). uellix_writer must hold SELECT and nothing more on stella_interactions, and SELECT+INSERT and nothing more on stella_suggestion_decisions when it exists.
